notes.title: #Update
notes.notes:
Greetings!

A new update, bringing new maps, a new Engineer feature, and other improvements.
Here's the list.

[New/Improved/Fixed]
[list]
[*] Added 4 new language support.
[*] Added more maps.
[*] Added effects on death units.
[*] Decreased camera swipe smooth time effect.
[*] Added a button to deselect a unit on the unit info panel.
[*] Fixed Germany and Soviet Union's inability to build aircraft carriers.
[*] Fixed German Dive Bomber's ability to attack at a range of 1.
[*] Engineers can now build roads.
[*] Reduced artillery's max range and MLRS's max range by 1.
[/list]
